title: Odile and the Monsoon
author: Beatrix Whitlock
blurb: Ulyana Underhill, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
